## Implemented and observed
- GET /beds/matrix: actual fresh ward/beds/counts, filtering/empty results, read failure hides stale actions and explicit read retry recovers. No invented ward/occupant data.
- POST /beds/{bed_id}/state: reviewed factual reason and frozen source snapshot; actor/permission/view and exact bed/ward preflight; original-key recovery, no automatic write retry. Actual Available→OutOfService→Available200, invalid reason422, Reserved refusal409, cashier403, double-click onePOST, lost real committed200 reconciled then explicit identical-key/body replay200 with replay flag. Final source positive writes200 request IDs 5d7163bc02db4497a3de464eb1fadd5c / 54e6861096ff4ec080a2de86a719a464.
- Rule guards cover Available/Dirty/Cleaning service targets and prevent Reserved/Occupied changes; Dirty/Cleaning/Occupied paths are policy-test evidence, no physical care/cleaning claimed. Prescribed state colours always include text, inspected in English/Urdu and both themes.
- Actual bed.state_changed from a second terminal updates tile/count incrementally, suppresses stale occupant data, rereads; a stale draft keeps its reason and disables confirmation. Genuine socket interruption produced Reconnecting then Live/resync and a full matrix read.
- Bilingual handbook, contextual controls, Admissions role guidance, tasks, recovery and actual screenshots included. F1/focus and keyboard/Settings100–250 exercised; no human gate claim.
